lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular spots arranged in roughly vertical columns along the lateral flank, transitioning to a more scattered distribution towards the posterior caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly higher pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal spot alignments to create a grid-like arrangement of nodes across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) clustered near the ventral-pectoral boundary and trailing along the lower mid-section.
